name: 99709 · Fairbanks, AK
findings: ZIP 99709 (Fairbanks) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99709 (Fairbanks) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
